question: Explain the meaning of cost of capital and its significance in financial decision-making.
sources: Cost of capital: concept and significance in financial decisions

points.label: Meaning
points.description: Cost of capital is the minimum rate of return a firm must earn on its investments to satisfy its providers of funds and keep the value of its shares unchanged.

points.label: Capital budgeting decisions
points.description: It is the discount rate or cut-off (hurdle) rate used to accept or reject projects.
points.basis: Cost of capital: use in investment evaluation

points.label: Capital structure decisions
points.description: It helps choose the mix of debt and equity that gives the lowest overall cost and highest value.
points.basis: Cost of capital: use in financing decisions

points.label: Other decisions and performance evaluation
points.description: It is used in decisions on leasing, dividends and working capital, and to judge whether management's returns exceed the cost of funds.
